kupa.title: Something went wrong
kupa.lead: This screen could not be shown because of an unexpected error.
kupa.body: Your saved data has not been affected. You can try the screen again or return to the Cupping & Hijama home.

aromaterapi.title: An unexpected problem occurred
aromaterapi.body: An error occurred while loading the Aromatherapy section. Your information is safe; in most cases trying again is enough.
